body: Fixed (1) systemctl --user hang on fresh boot → context.WithTimeout(2s), D-Bus timeout note; (2) goroutine QueueUpdateDraw race on quit → tuiLogger.stopped guard, ticker.Stop()+setStopped() before app.Stop(); (3) emily-agent missing from process list. emily.cli commit 807318d.
title: TUI: quit hang + process list fix on clean reboot (S6 done 2026-06-11)
